headline: Gaza: Two Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks across the strip
summary: Multiple strikes hit residential buildings and civilians in Deir al-Balah, Khan Yunis, and Gaza City, leaving several others injured.
details: Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip on Friday left two Palestinians dead and numerous others injured, according to an Anadolu Agency report.
The victims were identified as 33-year-old Mahmud Mohammad Fataier and 38-year-old Mohammad Abdel Nasser al-Khatib, both killed in Deir al-Balah.
In Deir al-Balah's Abu Arif Street, an Israeli drone targeted civilians, injuring two people, one of whom remains in critical condition.
According to Al-Awda Hospital, an Israeli airstrike destroyed a multi-story residential building east of the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza.
Sources indicate that Israeli intelligence warned residents to evacuate the area via phone before the building was destroyed by fighter jets.
Further strikes hit a house south of Deir al-Balah and the Al-Maslaha area west of Khan Yunis, where a drone attack on civilians left several injured, some critically.
In northern Gaza City, an Israeli attack in the Al-Saftawi neighborhood also left four more Palestinians injured.
caption:
Two Palestinians killed and dozens injured as Israeli strikes hit residential buildings and civilians across Gaza.

Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip on Friday left two Palestinians dead and numerous others injured, according to an Anadolu Agency report.

The victims were identified as 33-year-old Mahmud Mohammad Fataier and 38-year-old Mohammad Abdel Nasser al-Khatib, both killed in Deir al-Balah.

In Deir al-Balah's Abu Arif Street, an Israeli drone targeted civilians, injuring two people, one of whom remains in critical condition.

According to Al-Awda Hospital, an Israeli airstrike destroyed a multi-story residential building east of the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza.

Sources indicate that Israeli intelligence warned residents to evacuate the area via phone before the building was destroyed by fighter jets.

Further strikes hit a house south of Deir al-Balah and the Al-Maslaha area west of Khan Yunis, where a drone attack on civilians left several injured, some critically.

In northern Gaza City, an Israeli attack in the Al-Saftawi neighborhood also left four more Palestinians injured.

headline_marked: 4 missing after [[overcrowded boat capsizes]] in Sunamganj haor
headline: 4 missing after overcrowded boat capsizes in Sunamganj haor
summary: Search operations are underway to locate the missing passengers after a boat accident in the haor region of Sunamganj.
details: Four people have gone missing after an overcrowded boat capsized in a haor of Sunamganj.
The incident occurred when the vessel, carrying more passengers than its capacity, overturned in the open water.
Local rescue teams and divers are currently searching for the missing individuals.
Boat accidents in the haor regions are frequent, often attributed to overcrowding and lack of safety measures.
